primary_fix: V0.8.3 now separates universal reader features from conditional figure-study. Source-faithful bilingual text, inline terminology, inline citations with reference links, inline figure/table links, preview index and right-side viewer are mandatory for every paper. Figure-study is enabled only for CNS-family or biology/bioinformatics-heavy papers.

standard.use_for: conventional low-reading-difficulty method, engineering or clinical papers

figure_intensive.use_for: CNS-family main/sub-journal papers and biology/bioinformatics-heavy discovery papers

source_fidelity_contract.english: visible English body is the source text, not AI-authored prose or summary
source_fidelity_contract.chinese: Chinese is translation only; no summary, explanation, inference, added background or conclusion strengthening
source_fidelity_contract.sentence_pairing: one source scientific sentence to one Chinese translation sentence

inline_content_contract.terminology: term highlighting and clickable explanations are mandatory wherever the term dictionary matches the English or Chinese body
inline_content_contract.citations: citations remain at their source positions and resolve through referenceData; cited references expose an external DOI/publisher/arXiv/search link
inline_content_contract.figures_tables: Figure/Table/Extended Data/Supplementary mentions remain at their source positions and open the corresponding asset

pdf_asset_contract.principle: use PDF-native extraction rather than visual screenshot cropping whenever the source object is available
preferred_order: PDF vector/page clip exported as SVG
deterministic PDF-coordinate crop only when the first two are impossible
pdf_asset_contract.forbidden_default: manual visual screenshot crop used as the primary extraction method

interaction_contract.reason: legacy sentence, annotation and figure handlers may stop bubbling; terminology interaction cannot depend on bubble-phase delivery

component_format_contract.rule: A paper may supply text values only. It may not invent replacement DOM/classes or paper-specific typography for fixed hero/overview components.

regression_requirements: source English reconstructs the PDF text rather than an AI summary
English terminology remains highlighted and clickable
Chinese terminology remains highlighted when a Chinese alias is defined
citation numbers remain clickable at their original source positions
cited reference popup contains an external link
inline figure/table references remain clickable at their original source positions
figure/table preview cards and right-side viewer remain functional
standard profile exposes no figure-study UI
figure_intensive profile retains full panel/logical-block figure-study
term click opens a visible tooltip
second term click toggles the tooltip closed
Enter and Space activate a focused term
dynamic terms inserted after page load work without rebinding
hero metadata and overview use locked components
